name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday NOVEMBER 14, 2019
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Henderson, and Smith
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of October 10, 2019
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permit 09-02 Time Extension No. 1
SBA Monarch Towers III, LLC, Applicant
(Continued from October 10, 2019)
A request for a ten-year time extension for the operation of an existing major communication facility located at 2121 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 09-02 Time Extension No. 1 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 19-015
The Camp Transformation Center, Applicant
A request to establish a health and wellness fitness studio within an existing tenant space, located at 3005 East Palmdale Boulevard, Suite 21.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-043 approving Conditional Use Permit 19-015, and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Tentative Tract Map 61731 Time Extension No. 2
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to Tentative Tract Map 61731, a subdivision of approximately 10 acres into 37 single-family residential lots, located at the southeast corner of 60th Street East and Avenue Q-12.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-044 approving Tentative Tract Map 61731 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Tentative Tract Map 65278 Time Extension No. 2
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to Tentative Tract Map 65278, a subdivision of approximately five acres into 17 single-family residential lots, located at the southwest corner of 30th Street East and Avenue R-4.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC 2019-045 approving Tentative Tract Map 65278 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Negative Declaration. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
8D
8E. Site Plan Review 19-016/Conditional Use Permit 14-028 Major Modification No. 1
Iglesias Nueva Vida En Cristo, Applicant
A request to expand an existing religious assembly use located at 3030 East Avenue R-8.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-047 approving Site Plan Review 19-016 and Conditional Use Permit 14-028 Major Modification No. 1 and find that the project includes minor alterations to the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration for the previously approved project, as outlined within the Addendum. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8E
8F. Tentative Tract Map 71357 Time Extension No. 2
LA-DF Investment Fund 78, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to Tentative Tract Map 71357, a subdivision of approximately 37 acres into 99 single-family residential lots located south of Rancho Vista Boulevard, between Sungate Drive and Delson Drive.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-046 approving Tentative Tract Map 71357 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8F
8G. Tentative Tract Map 63412 Time Extension No. 2
West Palm Development Corporation, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to Tentative Tract Map 63412, a subdivision of approximately 10 acres into 28 single-family residential lots located at the northeast corner of Avenue R and 60th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 2019-048 approving Tentative Tract Map 63412 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8G
8H. Site Plan Review 19-011/Conditional Use Permit 09-15 Major Modification
Las Islas Marias, Applicant
A request to expand an existing bona fide restaurant and change the alcoholic beverage control license from a Type 41 (On-Sale Beer and Wine) to a Type 47 (On-Sale General), located at 2121 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-049 approving Site Plan Review 19-011 and Conditional Use Permit 09-15 Major Modification and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8H
9. Staff Communications
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, December 12, 2019, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
www.ci tyofpalmdale.org
Auxiliary Aids provided for Communication Accessibility upon 72 hour notice and request.
